claims.text: Customers frequently praise the company's customer service, noting that missing or broken parts were replaced quickly and without hassle.
Many reviewers report the lamp works well and delivers strong heat, though some note it gets very hot and requires keeping a distance.
Several customers say the lamp improved their skin and hair, including help with curly hair and skin conditions.
A few reviewers mention the lamp is large or oddly shaped, but most say they don't mind given the value.
A small number of negative reviews report serious problems: one says it burned a client's hair, and another says only one light gets hot.
